description: This file defines the interface for the Dictionary class used in an Android input method, including constants, class declaration, and method signatures related to word suggestion and validation within a dictionary data structure.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: A class providing methods for managing and querying a dictionary for word suggestions, validation, and related operations in an input method context.

methods.name: Dictionary
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dictionary with a data pointer and multipliers.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns suggested words based on input codes and various constraints.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word of specified length is valid in the dictionary.

methods.name: getWords
methods.description: Retrieves all words and their frequencies from the dictionary.

methods.name: countWordsChars
methods.description: Counts the total number of words and characters in the dictionary.

methods.name: ~Dictionary
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: countWordsHelper
methods.description: Recursive helper for counting words and characters.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address of a dictionary node at a given position.

methods.name: getFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of a word at a given position.

methods.name: searchForTerminalNode
methods.description: Searches for terminal nodes in the dictionary structure.

methods.name: getFirstBitOfByte
methods.description: Checks the first bit of a byte in the dictionary data.

methods.name: getSecondBitOfByte
methods.description: Checks the second bit of a byte in the dictionary data.

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.description: Determines if a node is terminal (end of a word).

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Gets the count value from a node.

methods.name: getChar
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the dictionary data.

methods.name: wideStrLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a wide string.

methods.name: sameAsTyped
methods.description: Checks if a word matches the typed input.

methods.name: checkFirstCharacter
methods.description: Verifies the first character of a word.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word to the dictionary.

methods.name: addWordBigram
methods.description: Adds a bigram (pair of words) to the dictionary.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase.

methods.name: getWordsRec
methods.description: Recursive helper to retrieve words from the dictionary.

methods.name: isValidWordRec
methods.description: Recursive helper to validate a word.

methods.name: registerNextLetter
methods.description: Registers the next possible letter in the dictionary context.
